i.norm: HTML entities that should be unescaped, covering: - named entities with and without trailing semicolons (e.g. Æ and &LT) - decimal and hex numeric character references (π 新) - case-insensitive named entities (© == ©) - invalid entity names that must be left as-is (&angst &!)
Strings whose entity-like tokens cannot be resolved should be returned unchanged. A leading digit (&0987654321;) and an unrecognised name (&unknown) are both left intact.
